extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent classifiers, patent attorneys and applicants working on wood‑treatment patents
extracted.subtask_description: Classification guidance for CPC subclass B27K (working or preserving wood or similar materials), including groups for impregnation, treatment methods, apparatus, impregnating agents, treated materials, and treatment purposes, with notes on precedence and cross‑classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-limiting references may be displayed
rubrics_metrics.description: In this subclass non-limiting references (in the sense of paragraph 39 of the Guide to the IPC) may still be displayed in the scheme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning that entries shown in curly braces or as examples may be non-limiting references; classifiers should consult IPC Guide paragraph 39 for interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 1/00 Damping wood
rubrics_metrics.description: Damping wood
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes apparatus (see B27K 1/02).

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 1/02 Apparatus for damping wood
rubrics_metrics.description: Apparatus
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers devices specifically for damping wood (classification under 1/00).

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 3/00 Impregnating wood (including pretreatment and impregnation aids)
rubrics_metrics.description: Impregnating wood, e.g. impregnation pretreatment, for example puncturing; Wood impregnation aids not directly involved in the impregnation process (dyeing, staining B27K 5/00).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers processes and apparatus for impregnation; cross-reference to B27K 5/00 for dyeing/staining.

rubrics_metrics.name: Last place priority rule for B27K 3/16 - 3/50
rubrics_metrics.description: In groups B27K 3/16 - B27K 3/50, the last place priority rule is applied, i.e. at each hierarchical level, in the absence of an indication to the contrary, impregnating agents are classified in the last appropriate place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When multiple applicable places exist within 3/16–3/50, place entries in the last appropriate subgroup unless indicated otherwise. (Note corresponds to IPC Note (1) relating to B27K 3/16 - B27K 3/34.)

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 3/002 Employing compositions comprising microorganisms
rubrics_metrics.description: {employing compositions comprising microorganisms}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific subgroup for impregnating compositions that include microorganisms; curly braces indicate non-limiting example/reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 3/005 Employing compositions comprising microparticles
rubrics_metrics.description: {employing compositions comprising microparticles}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify impregnating compositions containing microparticles here.

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 3/007 Employing compositions comprising nanoparticles
rubrics_metrics.description: {employing compositions comprising nanoparticles}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify impregnating compositions containing nanoparticles here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pretreatment of wood before impregnation
rubrics_metrics.description: {Pretreatment of wood before impregnation}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes operations performed to prepare wood for impregnation (e.g., puncturing). See related groups for pore opening and drying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drying (general reference F26B)
rubrics_metrics.description: {Drying (drying in general F26B)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drying steps related to impregnation are noted; general drying technology is classified in F26B.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pore opening (B27K 3/0214 precedence)
rubrics_metrics.description: {Pore opening (B27K 3/0214 takes precedence)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If pore opening is applicable classify in B27K 3/0214 where specified; precedence notes must be respected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of apparatus/techniques related to impregnation
rubrics_metrics.description: {Spraying apparatus, e.g. tunnels; Stationary devices on or in legs or poles; using melt impregnation; Controlling the process; using rods or tablets, or ampoules, e.g. inserted in pre-drilled cavities; using staples or nails; Vapour phase impregnation; involving an additional treatment during or after impregnation}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are example techniques and apparatus types associated with impregnation; many are shown as non-limiting examples (curly braces). Use specific subgroup numbers when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Groups for improving penetration and fixation of impregnating fluids
rubrics_metrics.description: {for improving the penetration of the impregnating fluid} . {for improving fixation (B27K 3/0285 takes precedence)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify methods used to improve penetration or fixation in the indicated subgroups; note that B27K 3/0285 takes precedence for fixation-related entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impregnating in open tanks
rubrics_metrics.description: Impregnating in open tanks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Straightforward method subgroup: open-tank impregnation processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sap stream methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Sap stream methods
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methods using the sap stream for impregnation are classified here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impregnating by pressure / vacuum / supercritical fluids
rubrics_metrics.description: Impregnating by pressure, e.g. vacuum impregnation; {along the fibers, i.e. longitudinal impregnation}; {using supercritical or high pressure fluids}; Apparatus
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes pressure-based impregnation techniques (vacuum, pressure, supercritical fluids) and longitudinal impregnation; apparatus subgroups exist for corresponding equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surface coating, injection and bandage methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Impregnating by coating the surface of the wood with an impregnating paste. {Injection apparatus}. Bandage methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surface coating, injection apparatus and bandage-based impregnation approaches are distinct technique subgroups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impregnating involving polymerisation (B27K 3/15 and cross-class C08L)
rubrics_metrics.description: Impregnating involving polymerisation {including use of polymer-containing impregnating agents (macromolecular compounds derived from lignocellulosic materials C08H; compositions of lignin-containing materials C08L 97/02)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When classifying in group B27K 3/15, also classify in the relevant groups of subclass C08L to define the chemical polymeric structure. Includes in-situ polymerisation during impregnation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impregnating without in-situ polymerisation; combined with grafting
rubrics_metrics.description: {Without in-situ polymerisation, condensation, or cross-linking reactions} . {Combined with grafting onto wood fibres}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subgroups for impregnating agents/processes that do not involve polymerisation/condensation/cross-linking, and for combined grafting treatments (precedence notes may apply).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inorganic impregnating agents (categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inorganic impregnating agents. {Compounds of boron}. {Compounds of phosphorus}. Compounds of alkaline earth metals. Compounds of alkali metals or ammonium. Compounds of zinc or copper. Compounds of mercury. Compounds of iron, aluminium, or chromium. Compounds of arsenic or antimony. Compounds of fluorine. Mixtures of different inorganic impregnating agents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists specific classes of inorganic chemicals used as impregnating agents; classifiers should use the most specific subgroup available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organic impregnating agents (categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: . Organic impregnating agents {(polymers B27K 3/15)}. {Heterocyclic compounds}. {Grafting onto wood fibres (B27K 3/156 takes precedence; macromolecular compounds derived from lignocellulosic materials C08H)}. Aliphatic compounds. Aromatic compounds {(B27K 3/343 takes precedence)}. halogenated. nitrated, or nitrated and halogenated. Tar; Mineral oil. Mixtures of different organic impregnating agents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies organic agent subclasses including heterocyclic, aliphatic, aromatic (with precedence notes), halogenated/nitrated, tar/mineral oil and mixtures; follow precedence notes (e.g., B27K 3/343, B27K 3/156).

rubrics_metrics.name: Impregnating agents containing mixtures of inorganic and organic compounds
rubrics_metrics.description: Impregnating agents containing mixtures of inorganic and organic compounds. Coal tar. Mineral oil.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the subgroup for mixed inorganic/organic impregnating agents; coal tar and mineral oil are highlighted examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials other than wood: reed, straw, cane, bamboo
rubrics_metrics.description: . {Reed}. {Straw}. 9/00 Chemical or physical treatment of reed, straw, or similar material (mechanical working of cane or the like B27J 1/00). 9/002 {Cane, bamboo}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate groups exist for treatment of reed, straw, cane and bamboo; curly-brace items are example references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wooden materials to be treated (articles, particles, multilayer articles)
rubrics_metrics.description: 2200/00 Wooden materials to be treated. 2200/10 Articles made of particles or fibres consisting of wood or other lignocellulosic material. 2200/15 Pretreated particles or fibres. 2200/30 Multilayer articles comprising wood.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify the type of wooden/lignocellulosic article being treated in these groups (particleboard, fibreboard, pretreated particles, multilayer constructions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the treatment (functional aims)
rubrics_metrics.description: 2240/00 Purpose of the treatment. 2240/10 Extraction of components naturally occurring in wood, cork, straw, cane or reed. 2240/15 Decontamination of previously treated wood. 2240/20 Removing fungi, molds or insects. 2240/30 Fireproofing. 2240/50 Ageing. 2240/60 Hydrophobation treatment. 2240/70 UV-protection. 2240/90 Improving the heat-storage capacity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classification by the objective of the treatment (e.g., pest removal, fireproofing, hydrophobic treatment, UV protection). Use the specific purpose subgroup when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 5/00 Treating of wood not provided for in groups (various physical/chemical methods)
rubrics_metrics.description: 5/00 Treating of wood not provided for in groups. Subgroups include 5/0005, 5/001, 5/0015 ... and list methods such as Electric discharges, plasma; Cryogenic treatment; Heating (by electric means); by magnetic fields; by using electromagnetic radiation or mechanical waves (infrared heating of wood B27K 5/001); Electron beam-radiation; Gamma-radiation; X-rays; Laser-light; Radio-waves, e.g. microwaves; Vibrations; Ultrasonic treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all group for treatment techniques not provided elsewhere; detailed physical and radiation-based methods are enumerated. Cross-reference infrared heating at B27K 5/001.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pressure, vacuum and thermal process notes (precedence and special cases)
rubrics_metrics.description: {using pressure (B27K 3/08 takes precedence)}. {Vacuum}. {Supercritical or high pressure fluids}. {Thermal treatments, i.e. involving chemical modification of wood at temperatures well over 100°C}. {using a well-defined temperature schedule}. {by employing wrappers}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When pressure-based methods overlap with the impregnation groups, precedence (e.g., B27K 3/08) applies. Thermal treatments that chemically modify wood at high temperature are noted separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Staining, dyeing and bleaching of wood (cross-references)
rubrics_metrics.description: Staining or dyeing wood {(wood staining compositions C09D 15/00)}; Bleaching wood (bleaching wood pulp D21C 9/10). 5/04 Combined bleaching or impregnating and drying of wood.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use C09D 15/00 for staining compositions and D21C 9/10 for bleaching pulp where relevant; combined bleaching/impregnating/drying has a specific subgroup 5/04.

rubrics_metrics.name: Softening or hardening of wood (including hardening subgroup)
rubrics_metrics.description: 5/06 Softening or hardening of wood. 5/065 {Hardening}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate subgroups for softening vs hardening processes; hardening called out explicitly.

rubrics_metrics.name: B27K 7/00 Treatment of cork
rubrics_metrics.description: 7/00 Chemical or physical treatment of cork (mechanical working of cork B27J 5/00)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers cork-specific treatment processes; mechanical working is classified in B27J 5/00.
